arc_chance_delta_threshold.chance_input.rule: Runtime chance parameter maps to Java chanceDelta argument d.

arc_chance_delta_threshold.method.rule: Arc Mathf.chanceDelta compares rand.nextFloat() against chance multiplied by Time.delta; runtime exposes only the deterministic threshold.

arc_chance_delta_threshold.threshold_exp.rule: Deterministic threshold side of rand.nextFloat() < d * Time.delta.

arc_is_power_of_two.bit_test.rule: Power-of-two bit test from Java expression value & value - 1.

arc_is_power_of_two.method.rule: Arc Mathf.isPowerOfTwo returns true only for nonzero values whose single-bit mask clears with value - 1.

arc_is_power_of_two.nonzero_guard.rule: Zero is explicitly not a power of two.

arc_is_power_of_two.value_input.rule: Runtime value parameter maps to Java isPowerOfTwo value.

arc_lerp_delta.from_input.rule: Runtime from_value maps to Java fromValue.

arc_lerp_delta.method.rule: Arc Mathf.lerpDelta delegates to lerp using clamp(progress * Time.delta).

arc_lerp_delta.progress_input.rule: Runtime progress maps to Java progress.

arc_lerp_delta.scaled_progress.rule: Progress multiplied by Java Time.delta before clamping.

arc_lerp_delta.to_input.rule: Runtime to_value maps to Java toValue.

arc_mathf_absin.formula.rule: Three-argument absin returns the scaled sine shifted into a positive half range.

arc_mathf_absin.mag_input.rule: Runtime magnitude parameter maps to Java mag.

arc_mathf_absin.scl_input.rule: Runtime scale parameter maps to Java scl.

arc_mathf_absin.sin_scaled.rule: Mathf.sin(radians, scl, mag) divides radians by scale before multiplying magnitude.

arc_mathf_absin.time_overload.rule: Two-argument absin delegates to Time.time and the three-argument overload.

arc_mathf_absin.value_input.rule: Runtime value parameter maps to Java absin input named in.

arc_mathf_approach.clamp_expr.rule: Approach clamps target delta to negative and positive speed bounds.

arc_mathf_approach.from_input.rule: Runtime from_value parameter maps to Java from.

arc_mathf_approach.method.rule: Mathf.approach moves from toward to by clamping the delta to linear speed.

arc_mathf_approach.result_expr.rule: Approach result adds the clamped delta to from.

arc_mathf_approach.speed_input.rule: Runtime speed parameter maps to Java speed.

arc_mathf_approach.to_input.rule: Runtime to_value parameter maps to Java to.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.approach_call.rule: ApproachDelta return value comes from the canonical approach helper with delta-scaled speed.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.delta_input.rule: Runtime source_delta parameter supplies Java Time.delta.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.from_input.rule: Runtime from_value parameter maps to Java from.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.method.rule: Mathf.approachDelta delegates to approach with speed multiplied by Time.delta.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.scaled_speed.rule: Delta-scaled speed multiplies Java speed by Time.delta.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.speed_input.rule: Runtime speed parameter maps to Java speed.

arc_mathf_approach_delta.to_input.rule: Runtime to_value parameter maps to Java to.

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.index_expr.rule: Cosine lookup index with PI / 2 offset and sinMask.

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.method.rule: Arc Mathf.cos uses the sine lookup table offset by PI / 2.

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.rad_to_index.java_expr: private static final float radToIndex = sinCount / radFull;

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.radians_input.rule: Runtime radians maps to Java radians parameter.

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.sin_count.java_expr: private static final int sinCount = sinMask + 1;

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.sin_mask.java_expr: private static final int sinMask = ~(-1 << sinBits);

arc_mathf_cos_lookup.sin_table_init.rule: Default sine table entry formula used by cosine lookup.

arc_mathf_cos_scaled.mag_input.rule: Runtime mag maps to Java mag.

arc_mathf_cos_scaled.method.rule: Arc Mathf.cos scaled overload divides radians by scl, delegates to cos, and multiplies by mag.

arc_mathf_cos_scaled.radians_input.rule: Runtime radians maps to Java radians.

arc_mathf_cos_scaled.scl_input.rule: Runtime scl maps to Java scl.

arc_mathf_mod_float.divisor_input.rule: Runtime divisor maps to Java n.

arc_mathf_mod_float.method.rule: Arc Mathf.mod(float,float) normalizes modulo for negative float values.

arc_mathf_mod_float.normalized_mod.rule: Final modulo by divisor returns normalized result.

arc_mathf_mod_float.offset_mod.rule: Adds divisor after raw remainder to shift negative values into positive range.

arc_mathf_mod_float.raw_mod.rule: Initial Java float remainder before positive normalization.

arc_mathf_mod_float.value_input.rule: Runtime value maps to Java f.

arc_mathf_num.method.rule: Arc Mathf.num(boolean) converts true to 1 and false to 0.

arc_mathf_num.ternary.rule: Boolean ternary used by Arc Mathf.num(boolean).

arc_mathf_num.value_input.rule: Runtime value maps to Java b.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.cardinal_overrides.rule: Static initializer pins cardinal sine table values exactly.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.index_expr.rule: Sine lookup index multiplies radians by radToIndex and masks by sinMask.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.method.rule: Arc Mathf.sin(float) reads radians from the shared sine lookup table.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.rad_to_index.java_expr: private static final float radToIndex = sinCount / radFull;

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.radians_input.rule: Runtime radians maps to Java radians.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.return_expr.rule: Sine lookup returns the selected sinTable entry.

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.sin_count.java_expr: private static final int sinCount = sinMask + 1;

arc_mathf_sin_lookup.sin_mask.java_expr: private static final int sinMask = ~(-1 << sinBits);

arc_mathf_sin_scaled.mag_input.rule: Runtime mag maps to Java mag.

arc_mathf_sin_scaled.method.rule: Arc Mathf.sin scaled overload divides radians by scl, delegates to sin, and multiplies by mag.

arc_mathf_sin_scaled.radians_input.rule: Runtime radians maps to Java radians.

arc_mathf_sin_scaled.scl_input.rule: Runtime scl maps to Java scl.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.cardinal_loop.rule: Static initializer visits cardinal degree samples.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.cardinal_ninet.rule: Pins ninety degrees to exact one.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.cardinal_one_e.rule: Pins one-eighty degrees to exact zero.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.cardinal_two_s.rule: Pins two-seventy degrees to exact negative one.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.cardinal_zero.rule: Pins zero degrees to exact zero.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.deg_to_index.java_expr: private static final float degToIndex = sinCount / degFull;

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.index_input.rule: Runtime index maps to static initializer loop variable i.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.loop.rule: Static initializer iterates every sinTable index.

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.rad_full.java_expr: private static final float radFull = PI * 2;

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.sin_count.java_expr: private static final int sinCount = sinMask + 1;

arc_mathf_sin_table_value.sin_mask.java_expr: private static final int sinMask = ~(-1 << sinBits);

arc_random_seed_float_max.max_input.rule: Runtime max_value maps to Java max.

arc_random_seed_float_max.multiply_max.rule: Final result multiplies seeded float by max.

arc_random_seed_float_max.next_float.rule: Float sample comes from seeded Rand.nextFloat.

arc_random_seed_float_max.seed_input.rule: Runtime source_seed maps to Java seed.

arc_random_seed_float_max.seed_scale.rule: Arc seeds this overload by multiplying seed by 99999 before Rand.setSeed.

arc_random_seed_float_max.set_seed.rule: Shared Arc seed Rand receives the scaled seed.

arc_random_seed_int.bound.rule: Inclusive integer overload converts min/max to exclusive bound.

arc_random_seed_int.max_input.rule: Runtime max_value maps to Java max.

arc_random_seed_int.min_input.rule: Runtime min_value maps to Java min.

arc_random_seed_int.power_of_two_next_in.rule: Power-of-two branch advances the Rand sequence once.

arc_random_seed_int.return_expr.rule: Final result offsets bounded nextInt by min.

arc_random_seed_int.seed_input.rule: Runtime source_seed maps to Java seed.

arc_random_seed_int.set_seed.rule: Integer overload seeds Rand with seed directly.

lerp_delta.method.rule: Mathf.lerpDelta delegates to lerp using clamp(progress * Time.delta).

lerp_delta.scaled_progress.rule: Progress multiplied by Java Time.delta before clamping.

mathf_approach_delta.approach_call.rule: ApproachDelta delegates to approach(from, to, scaled speed).

mathf_approach_delta.delta_input.rule: Runtime source_delta parameter supplies Java Time.delta.

mathf_approach_delta.method.rule: Mathf.approachDelta delegates to approach with speed multiplied by Time.delta.

mathf_approach_delta.scaled_speed.rule: Delta-scaled speed multiplies Java speed by Time.delta.

mathf_dst.method.rule: Mathf.dst computes Euclidean distance from coordinate deltas.

mathf_dst.sqrt_expr.rule: Distance is sqrt(xd * xd + yd * yd).

mathf_dst.xd_expr.rule: X delta subtracts x1 from x2.

mathf_dst.yd_expr.rule: Y delta subtracts y1 from y2.

mathf_lerp_delta.method.rule: Mathf.lerpDelta delegates to lerp using clamp(progress * Time.delta).

mathf_lerp_delta.scaled_progress.rule: Progress multiplied by Java Time.delta before clamping.
